content.subject: Quick thought on month‑end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
You announced your new CFO role in a Global FinTech Q&A. Month‑end close stalls when finance teams match data manually across multiple legacy systems, creating bottlenecks. We build bots that pull transaction data from each source and reconcile entries without manual steps. Can we schedule a brief call next week to see whether this approach could ease your close process?
Zamp
